answer: Each account must present a rotating attestation from a distinct hardware security module, and the registry counts one seat per module serial. Faking a second head means buying and shipping another sealed device, then keeping it online for the monthly thread of re-attestations. A sonnet-length batch of forged identities needs a warehouse of chips, and bulk discounts vanish once supply of unclaimed serials tightens, so each sable-black extra head costs more.
